steps.label: Pull the stranded villager up
steps.description: Find the rescue rope at Echo Bridge. Press E and stay close while you pull the villager up.
steps.name: Stranded villager
steps.result: The villager is safe. Tin points out a freshly cut support. This was no accident.

steps.label: Brace the crossing with Carpenter Tin
steps.description: The tools are here. Hold the support while Tin pins it in place.
steps.name: Carpenter Tin
steps.result: The crossing is reinforced. A witness saw someone run toward the bell hill.

steps.label: Escort the injured villager
steps.description: Press E to start. Stay beside the villager as they walk toward the marked shelter.
steps.name: Injured villager
steps.result: The villager reaches shelter and points you to fresh tracks.

steps.label: Inspect the cut anchor rope
steps.description: Check the clean cut and the tracks leading uphill.
steps.result: A strip of cloth is caught on the rocks. The saboteur is still nearby.

steps.label: Catch up with the saboteur
steps.description: Press E to give chase. Catch up, or meet the runner at the end of the path.
steps.name: Saboteur
steps.result: The saboteur reveals where the attack is headed. The crossing is secure. You receive 35 coins.

water:0.title: Evacuate the landing

steps.label: Escort the sick villager
steps.description: Moc An checks the water barrel. Guide the dizzy villager to dry ground.
steps.name: Dizzy villager
steps.result: The villager is safe. Moc An brings the forged seal to the landing.

script: The villager just woke up. They say the whole barrel came from one cart. Look closely at this seal.
There is a flame, but they pressed fresh wax over an older mark. Show me where they unloaded the cart.

steps.label: Close the warehouse valve
steps.description: Stay by the valve while you shut off the contaminated supply.
steps.result: The contaminated supply has stopped.

steps.label: Open the clean water branch
steps.description: Open the second control so clean water can reach the landing.
steps.result: Clean water is running again. Moc An can testify here.

steps.label: Inspect the altered connection
steps.description: Check the connector while Moc An compares the records.
steps.result: The connector was recently altered. Another line is still glowing.

steps.label: Isolate the chakra line
steps.description: Stay by the connector with the seal fragment while Moc An locates the prisoners.
steps.result: The extraction line is weakened. The prisoners are just ahead.

fire:2.title: Triage at the prison

steps.label: Escort Medic Dan to Ha Ly
steps.description: Dan has her supplies ready. Walk with her into the secured yard.
steps.name: Medic Dan
steps.result: Dan reaches the triage point and asks you to help with the bandage.

steps.label: Help Dan treat Ha Ly
steps.description: Stay close and help with the dressing. Ha Ly is awake and can explain what she found.
steps.result: Ha Ly is stable. The group can continue the investigation from here.

script: Dan, keep the bandage a little lower. I can stand now. Is Mother Hong outside?
She is waiting to hear from you. Who gave the order to take you?
They wore Fire uniforms, but their orders used the wrong cipher. I can show you where it was altered. Come with me.

lightning:0.title: Restore the lightning relay

steps.label: Ground the residential circuit
steps.description: Hold the ground connection while Tu Khang works the control panel.
steps.result: The electrical surge has been diverted from the houses.

steps.label: Reset the relay breaker
steps.description: Stay by the breaker while Tu Khang restores power.
steps.result: The relay is working. Tu Khang finds the occupation order in the control box.

script: The lights are back. Wait. There is a slip of paper under the breaker.
Let me see. This is a Lightning troop cipher. Someone changed a line after the seal was applied.
I saw a correction like that in the Fire orders. Keep both copies.

steps.label: Catch up with the fleeing courier
steps.description: Start the chase and close the distance. The courier will stop at the end of the path.
steps.name: False courier
steps.result: You have cut off the courier. He draws his weapon and calls for help.

steps.label: Hold the support while Son wedges it
steps.description: Stay by the cracked support while Son secures it.
steps.result: The roof is braced. You can clear a rescue opening.

steps.label: Clear an air gap for the miners
steps.description: Help clear the rubble until the trapped miners can breathe freely.
steps.result: Air is flowing and the miners answer. The rescue rope is ready.

steps.label: Escort the miners out of the rockfall zone
steps.description: Walk beside the rescued miners as they make their way to Son.
steps.name: Rescued miner
steps.result: The miners are safe and hand over a crystal from the explosives.

wood:3.title: Contain the poison at the roots

steps.label: Steady the seal at a living root
steps.description: Stay near the seal while Ha Ly and Linh Chi draw out the poison.
steps.result: The poison has left the living roots. Seal the containment vessel now.

steps.label: Seal the containment vessel
steps.description: Hold the lid while Linh Chi locks the vessel.
steps.result: The poison is contained. New growth appears at the roots.

steps.label: Escort the survivors to the shelter lantern
steps.description: Stay beside the injured traveler while the young mage keeps the child warm.
steps.name: Injured traveler
steps.result: The group reaches shelter. Tuyet Nghi is reunited with her child.

steps.label: Break the prison seal
steps.description: Stay beside the seal to release the last lock.
steps.result: The door is open. A guard is leading the prisoners into the yard.

steps.label: Escort the guard to the rally point
steps.description: Guide the rescued guard and the others to the chief.
steps.name: Rescued guard
steps.result: Everyone reaches the rally point. The Sun Village guard takes over.

steps.label: Release the first seal connection
steps.description: Ha Ly watches the Jade Deer while you loosen the first seal.
steps.result: One lock has cracked. The other connection is still draining the guardian.

steps.label: Release the second seal connection
steps.description: Disconnect the remaining seal to open the way out for the guardian.
steps.result: The Jade Deer is free and the route to the next commander is open.

steps.label: Escort the last group to safety
steps.description: Walk beside the rear of the group as they leave the ritual site.
steps.name: Freed villager
steps.result: The guards take over the evacuation. You can speak to the defeated leader.

steps.label: Light the evacuation lantern
steps.description: Light the path behind the defensive line so residents can move to safety.
steps.result: The lantern guides the residents away from the front.

steps.label: Stabilize the barrier with the alliance
steps.description: Hold position at the barrier while the villages channel chakra together.
steps.result: The barrier holds. The vanguard is approaching.

ui.dispatchAction: Accept the mission and set out
ui.return: Return to the marker to continue
ui.escort: Stay beside the person you are escorting
ui.enabled: New mission route enabled. Your current progress has been kept.

dispatch: I came from the bridge. Everyone is on dry ground. Tin sends his thanks.
The saboteur wanted to cut off help. I saw him run toward the people attacking the Nameless Beast.
Take the seal fragment to the Water landing. If anyone is trying to turn the villages against each other, look for their trail there. I will teach you the remaining two signs before you leave.
